headline: BNP nominates Mirza Fakhrul as presidential candidate
summary: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party has chosen its Secretary General to contest for the presidency.
details: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has officially nominated Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir for the position of President of Bangladesh.
Mirza Fakhrul, who currently serves as the party's Secretary General, was selected as the candidate to represent the party in the upcoming presidential election.
The decision marks a significant move by the BNP as it positions its key leadership for the highest office in the land.
Party sources indicate that Fakhrul was chosen based on his experience and leadership within the party structure.

headline_marked: Hasan Mahmud takes 6 wickets as [[Bangladesh bowl Australia out for 198]]
headline: Hasan Mahmud takes 6 wickets as Bangladesh bowl Australia out for 198
summary: Hasan Mahmud becomes the first Bangladeshi bowler to take a five-wicket haul in Australia, leading the Tigers to a dominant opening day in Darwin.
details: Hasan Mahmud produced a career-best 6 for 55 in 17 overs, bowling Australia out for 198 in 53 overs on the opening day of the first Test at Marrara Stadium in Darwin.
This landmark spell makes Hasan the first Bangladesh bowler to ever take a five-wicket haul on Australian soil, surpassing Mashrafe Bin Mortaza's previous best of 3 for 74 in 2003.
Hasan's success came from a consistent approach, repeatedly challenging batters around the off-stump channel. He claimed key wickets including Travis Head, Pat Cummins, and Steve Smith.
The Tigers' pace attack dominated the match, with Taskin Ahmed and Ebadot Hossain adding two wickets each. The three seamers accounted for all 10 Australian wickets.
This marks only the second time in Test history that Bangladesh's pacers have taken all 10 wickets in an innings, a feat previously achieved against Pakistan in Rawalpindi in 2024.
Former Australian opener David Warner praised the visitors' accuracy, noting it was the first time he had seen an opposition team hit their mark so effectively from the start in Australia.
caption:
History made in Darwin! 🇧🇩
Hasan Mahmud becomes the first Bangladeshi to take a 5-wicket haul in Australia.

Hasan Mahmud produced a career-best 6 for 55 in 17 overs, bowling Australia out for 198 in 53 overs on the opening day of the first Test at Marrara Stadium in Darwin.

This landmark spell makes Hasan the first Bangladesh bowler to ever take a five-wicket haul on Australian soil, surpassing Mashrafe Bin Mortaza's previous best of 3 for 74 in 2003.

Hasan's success came from a consistent approach, repeatedly challenging batters around the off-stump channel. He claimed key wickets including Travis Head, Pat Cummins, and Steve Smith.

The Tigers' pace attack dominated the match, with Taskin Ahmed and Ebadot Hossain adding two wickets each. The three seamers accounted for all 10 Australian wickets.

This marks only the second time in Test history that Bangladesh's pacers have taken all 10 wickets in an innings, a feat previously achieved against Pakistan in Rawalpindi in 2024.

Former Australian opener David Warner praised the visitors' accuracy, noting it was the first time he had seen an opposition team hit their mark so effectively from the start in Australia.
